_comment.about: Per-game config. `hoop-tape-miner new-game` copies this to workspace/teams/<opponent-slug>/<date>/game.json. Keys named _comment are documentation and are ignored by every stage.
_comment.name: Free-text title of the game, shown nowhere critical.
_comment.video: Path to our game video (absolute, or relative to this folder). Stages also take --video explicitly.
_comment.us: Our team. team = display name; colour = the label you gave our jersey cluster in run/cluster_names.json when it uses colour words (not needed if you label clusters us/them); hex = optional chart/page colour #rrggbb (neutral default when missing); label = free-text jersey description; focus_player = optional jersey number for a player figure in `hoop-tape-miner report`.
_comment.them: The opponent, same fields as us (no focus_player).
_comment.periods: Playing periods in seconds of OUR video, [[start, end], ...], e.g. two halves [[0, 1200], [1320, 2400]]. Required by `analyze`; gaps between periods are shaded as breaks in `momentum`.
_comment.rosters: Jersey numbers (strings) per side. Jersey reads that are not on the roster are rejected; leave a list empty to accept any number.
_comment.result: Final and halftime score, read by `hoop-tape-miner html` for the score band. Leave null until known. us_side / them_side = home or away.
_comment.narration: Optional. voices = edge-tts voice per language for `hoop-tape-miner narrate`, either a voice name or {voice, rate}; defaults zh-CN-YunjianNeural / en-US-AndrewNeural.
